title.zh-CN: 社会主义民主政治本质特征

prompt.zh-CN: 社会主义民主政治的本质特征是什么？
prompt.en-US: What is commonly stated as the essential feature of socialist democracy in China?

text.en-US: Leadership of the Communist Party of China

reveal.zh-CN: 答案是人民当家作主。全过程人民民主是重要实现形式和制度表达之一。
reveal.en-US: The answer is the people running the country. Whole-process people's democracy is an important form and institutional expression.
